_comment: Draft lines for the battle talk bar (docs/gameplay/17_WEAPONS_AND_PLAYS.md §9). Not read by the game yet: when the
system is built, this becomes assets/data/battle_talk.json (by key in resources.json) and gets the other languages.
levelGap: said at the start of a fight by the level difference (muchWeaker 5+ below ... muchStronger 5+ above),
20 each. afterHit: said after a moment (resisted, weakHit, perfect, miss, selfLowHp, foeLowHp), 50 in all.
cardHints: said when the player holds the monster's card; {name} the monster, {type} a damage type word, {pct}
the percent. idle: small talk and cold jokes, 100, said when nothing else is due.

muchWeaker.zh_TW: 這怪好弱，好無聊的爛怪。
muchWeaker.en: This one's weak. What a dull little pest.
I could beat this with my eyes closed.
You sure you want to stand in my way?
Not even enough for a warm-up.
Sigh. Another small fry.

muchWeaker.zh_TW: 快點結束吧，我還有正事。
muchWeaker.en: Let's make this quick. I have places to be.
I almost feel bad hitting you.

muchWeaker.zh_TW: 你的同伴呢？叫大哥來啦。
muchWeaker.en: Where are your friends? Go get your big brother.
One hit. Hold still.

muchWeaker.zh_TW: 這層的怪都這麼客氣嗎？
muchWeaker.en: Are all the monsters on this floor this polite?
My weapon is yawning.
I won't even get experience from this.
Come on, give me a challenge.
You're here to drop some gold, right?
Easy. Way too easy.

muchWeaker.zh_TW: 我先讓你一招……算了，不讓。
muchWeaker.en: I'll give you a free hit... no, never mind.
This kind falls if I just look at it.
Hurry up, I'm on a schedule.
Fine. Quick and clean.
You should go back to the first floor.

weaker.en: Shouldn't be hard.
Stay careful and it'll be fine.
Looks like I have the upper hand.
Steady hits, that's all.
Don't get sloppy. Small ones bite too.
I can handle this one.
Keep the rhythm, one hit at a time.
I think it's a little scared of me.
After this one, I'll patch up.
Nice. Good practice.
Watch how it moves.
Watch for the "!" over its head.

weaker.zh_TW: 這種程度，正適合試新招。
weaker.en: Just right for trying a new move.
Just don't let it touch me.
Take it in one go.
I'm stronger, but no underestimating.
Its hits shouldn't hurt much.
Alright, let's win this cleanly.

weaker.zh_TW: 打得完美一點，拿個 S。
weaker.en: Let's play it perfect and get an S.
Combo practice time.

even.en: Time both my guard and my attacks.

even.zh_TW: 它的攻擊有節奏，看清楚。
even.en: Its attacks have a rhythm. Read it.

even.zh_TW: 我感覺到它也在觀察我。
even.en: I can feel it studying me too.
Don't get greedy. Guard when it's time.
This one's about as strong as me.
Let's see what it does first.
Pin it down with perfect combos.

even.zh_TW: 破防之後就是我的回合。
even.en: Once it breaks, it's my turn.
Let's see who has more patience.

stronger.en: I might have to push hard here.
I have to guard. Can't tank these.

stronger.zh_TW: 我應該先練一下再來的。

stronger.en: Wait for its move, then strike back.
Land a parry and I've got a chance.
Save the ultimate for the break.
That look in its eyes is dangerous.
If I can just survive this wave...

muchStronger.en: I don't think I can win. Should I run?
This feels deadly... do I go all in?

muchStronger.zh_TW: 這不是我現在能打的對手。
muchStronger.en: This isn't a fight I can take right now.

muchStronger.zh_TW: 它一下就能打掉我一半的血！
muchStronger.en: One hit from it takes half my HP!
Think of something, or it's over.
My hands are shaking.
Retreat, train, come back later?
Where did this monster come from?!
Do I take the gamble...
Full guard, look for a way out.
No way, it's too strong!

muchStronger.zh_TW: 這層不該出現這種東西。
muchStronger.en: Something like this shouldn't be on this floor.

muchStronger.zh_TW: 如果能破防，也許還有一絲希望。
muchStronger.en: If I can break it, maybe there's a chance.
All or nothing!
At least let me go down with style.
I'll remember you. Next time.
This one's down to luck.
Staying alive comes first.
It's smiling... it's laughing at me.

muchStronger.zh_TW: 快逃——不，等等，先擋住這下！
muchStronger.en: Run— no, wait, block this one first!

resisted.zh_TW: 打了不痛？是不是要換武器？
resisted.en: That didn't hurt it? Should I switch weapons?
It doesn't seem to fear this kind of attack.

resisted.zh_TW: 傷害好低……換個招式試試。
resisted.en: So little damage... let's try another move.
That move barely works on it.
It resists this. Maybe try magic?
Half my magic got soaked up...

resisted.zh_TW: 再這樣打下去會打很久。
resisted.en: At this rate, this'll take forever.

resisted.zh_TW: 看看卡片上寫它怕什麼。
resisted.en: Let me check its card for what it fears.

weakHit.en: So it's weak to ranged attacks.
So it's weak to close combat.

perfect.en: I've gotten good at this move.

perfect.zh_TW: 繼續保持，S 評價在望。
perfect.en: Keep it up, an S is in sight.

selfLowHp.en: One more hit and I'm in trouble.

cardHints.en: The card says: {name} is weak to {type}.
{name}'s shell is tough; {type} barely gets through.
{name} is fast; {type} hits it more easily.
{name} has a magic shield; break it with {type} first.
{name} hates being hit from a distance.

cardHints.zh_TW: {name}不怕任何一種武器……只能硬打。
cardHints.en: {name} fears no weapon... just grind it down.
{name} resists all three by {pct}%. A hard one.

cardHints.zh_TW: 看{name}頭上的驚嘆號，它的重擊很痛。

cardHints.en: {name} attacks in bursts; guard each one.
{name}'s seal has to be drawn to block it.
{name} has a lot of HP. Settle in.
{name} attacks slowly. Combo in the gaps.
{name} summons friends. Take it out first.
{name} is weak to {type} but resists the other two.

cardHints.zh_TW: {name}的卡片我有兩張了，打法我很熟。
cardHints.en: I have two of {name}'s cards. I know how to fight it.

idle.zh_TW: 今天天氣不錯，適合打怪。
idle.en: Nice weather today. Good for monster hunting.

idle.zh_TW: 塔裡沒有天氣啦……
idle.en: There's no weather inside the tower...

idle.zh_TW: 肚子有點餓了。
idle.en: I'm getting a bit hungry.

idle.zh_TW: 回去要好好睡一覺。
idle.en: I need a good night's sleep after this.

idle.zh_TW: 這層的地板好滑。
idle.en: The floor on this level is slippery.

idle.zh_TW: 誰在塔裡蓋這麼多樓梯的？
idle.en: Who built so many stairs in this tower?

idle.zh_TW: 背包好重，都是藥水。
idle.en: My bag is heavy. All potions.

idle.zh_TW: 我是不是忘了關燈？
idle.en: Did I forget to turn off the lights?

idle.zh_TW: 聽說頂樓有寶藏。
idle.en: They say there's treasure on the top floor.

idle.zh_TW: 村長的鬍子又變長了。
idle.en: The elder's beard got longer again.

idle.zh_TW: 等等打完要去哪吃飯？
idle.en: Where should I eat after this?

idle.zh_TW: 這把武器我越用越順手。
idle.en: This weapon feels better every day.

idle.zh_TW: 今天的運氣應該不錯。
idle.en: Feeling lucky today.

idle.zh_TW: 塔裡的空氣有點悶。
idle.en: The air in here is a bit stuffy.

idle.zh_TW: 有沒有人聽到奇怪的聲音？
idle.en: Did anyone else hear that noise?

idle.zh_TW: 我的鞋子破了一個洞。
idle.en: My shoe has a hole in it.

idle.zh_TW: 下次帶便當來。
idle.en: Next time I'm bringing a lunch box.

idle.zh_TW: 怪物們也要上班吧。
idle.en: Monsters have jobs too, I guess.

idle.zh_TW: 這隻怪看起來心情不好。
idle.en: This one looks like it's having a bad day.

idle.zh_TW: 打完這層就休息一下。
idle.en: I'll rest after this floor.

idle.zh_TW: 想念村子裡的麵包。
idle.en: I miss the village bread.

idle.zh_TW: 塔頂的風景一定很漂亮。
idle.en: The view from the top must be beautiful.

idle.zh_TW: 我的頭髮是不是亂了？
idle.en: Is my hair a mess?

idle.zh_TW: 今天的戰鬥特別多。
idle.en: Lots of fights today.

idle.zh_TW: 這把劍要磨一磨了。
idle.en: This sword needs sharpening.

idle.zh_TW: 弓弦好像有點鬆。
idle.en: The bowstring feels a little loose.

idle.zh_TW: 法杖上的寶石在發光。
idle.en: The gem on my staff is glowing.

idle.zh_TW: 聽說商人進了新貨。
idle.en: Heard the merchant got new stock.

idle.zh_TW: 寫日記的時候要寫今天。
idle.en: Today goes in the diary.

idle.zh_TW: 好想泡個溫泉。
idle.en: I could really use a hot spring.

idle.zh_TW: 這次一定要拿到 S。
idle.en: This time I'm getting an S.

idle.zh_TW: 這怪的樣子有點可愛。
idle.en: This monster is kind of cute.

idle.zh_TW: 可愛也要打。
idle.en: Cute or not, it's going down.

idle.zh_TW: 今天的星星應該很亮。
idle.en: The stars should be bright tonight.

idle.zh_TW: 塔裡的時間過得好快。
idle.en: Time flies in this tower.

idle.zh_TW: 我是不是在第幾層迷路了？
idle.en: Wait, which floor am I on?

idle.zh_TW: 村裡的貓不知道好不好。
idle.en: I wonder how the village cat is doing.

idle.zh_TW: 口渴了，等下喝水。
idle.en: Thirsty. Water later.

idle.zh_TW: 這場打完要伸個懶腰。
idle.en: Big stretch after this fight.

idle.zh_TW: 今天也要平安回家。
idle.en: Getting home safe today too.

idle.zh_TW: 有人在這裡掉了金幣嗎？
idle.en: Did someone drop gold here?

idle.zh_TW: 寶箱裡最好是好東西。
idle.en: That chest better have something good.

idle.zh_TW: 我好像聞到烤肉的味道。
idle.en: I think I smell barbecue.

idle.zh_TW: 戰鬥前要先深呼吸。
idle.en: Deep breath before the fight.

idle.zh_TW: 今天的我狀態很好。
idle.en: I'm in great shape today.

idle.zh_TW: 腳有點痠了。
idle.en: My legs are getting sore.

idle.zh_TW: 剛剛那層的音樂好聽。
idle.en: The music on the last floor was nice.

idle.zh_TW: 我的影子好像比我還緊張。
idle.en: My shadow looks more nervous than me.

idle.zh_TW: 塔的牆上有人畫塗鴉。
idle.en: Someone drew graffiti on the tower walls.

idle.zh_TW: 這次升級要點哪個屬性呢？
idle.en: Which stat should I raise next level?

idle.zh_TW: 為什麼史萊姆不會說謊？因為它太透明了。
idle.en: Why can't slimes lie? They're too transparent.

idle.zh_TW: 骷髏為什麼不打架？因為它沒有膽。
idle.en: Why don't skeletons fight? They don't have the guts.

idle.zh_TW: 蝙蝠為什麼成績好？因為牠倒背如流。
idle.en: Why do bats ace exams? They know everything upside down.

idle.zh_TW: 魔像最怕什麼？怕被說是石頭腦袋。
idle.en: What does a golem fear? Being called a rockhead.

idle.zh_TW: 為什麼弓箭手不愛聊天？因為他們都直接切入重點。
idle.en: Why don't archers chat? They get straight to the point.

idle.zh_TW: 劍士為什麼常常道歉？因為他太刀子嘴了。
idle.en: Why does the swordsman apologise so much? Too sharp a tongue.

idle.zh_TW: 法師的寵物是什麼？咒狗。
idle.en: What's a wizard's pet? A spell-ter dog... okay, a hex-hound.

idle.zh_TW: 塔裡的電梯呢？喔，叫樓梯。
idle.en: Where's the elevator in this tower? Oh. Stairs.

idle.zh_TW: 鬼魂為什麼不說謊？因為一眼就被看穿。
idle.en: Why can't ghosts lie? You can see right through them.

idle.zh_TW: 吸血鬼不吃什麼？大蒜，還有我的冷笑話。
idle.en: What won't a vampire eat? Garlic. And my jokes.

idle.zh_TW: 木乃伊為什麼不度假？怕被拆封。
idle.en: Why don't mummies take vacations? Afraid to unwind.

idle.zh_TW: 為什麼龍不玩捉迷藏？太好找了。
idle.en: Why don't dragons play hide and seek? Too easy to spot.

idle.zh_TW: 火精靈為什麼生氣？因為一點就著。
idle.en: Why is the fire imp so angry? Short fuse.

idle.zh_TW: 為什麼螃蟹不分享？因為牠很自私（蟹）。
idle.en: Why don't crabs share? They're shellfish.

idle.zh_TW: 巨魔為什麼不洗澡？因為怕變成『美』魔。
idle.en: Why don't trolls bathe? They're afraid of getting troll-y clean.

idle.zh_TW: 哥布林最愛的音樂？搖滾，因為牠們都在洞穴。
idle.en: A goblin's favourite music? Rock. They live in caves.

idle.zh_TW: 為什麼勇者總是很冷？因為身上都是冷笑話。
idle.en: Why is the hero always cold? Too many cold jokes.

idle.zh_TW: 樓梯為什麼累？因為一直被踩。
idle.en: Why are the stairs tired? People keep stepping on them.

idle.zh_TW: 藥水為什麼紅？因為被我盯著看害羞了。
idle.en: Why is the potion red? It's blushing because I'm staring.

idle.zh_TW: 寶箱為什麼鎖著？因為它有秘密。
idle.en: Why is the chest locked? It has secrets.

idle.zh_TW: 我跟史萊姆有什麼共同點？都很黏人。
idle.en: What do I have in common with a slime? We're both clingy.

idle.zh_TW: 為什麼弓不會累？因為它總是放鬆弦。
idle.en: Why doesn't the bow get tired? It knows how to unwind its string.

idle.zh_TW: 法杖為什麼高？因為它是長輩（杖輩）。
idle.en: Why is the staff so tall? It's the elder of the weapons.

idle.zh_TW: 為什麼盾牌人緣好？因為它總是挺你。
idle.en: Why is the shield so popular? It always has your back.

idle.zh_TW: 為什麼惡魔不開車？怕被開罰單——天罰。
idle.en: Why don't demons drive? Afraid of divine traffic tickets.

idle.zh_TW: 聽說最後一層的怪最怕冷笑話。
idle.en: I hear the top-floor boss hates cold jokes.

idle.zh_TW: 那我現在是在攻擊你嗎？
idle.en: So, am I attacking you right now?

idle.zh_TW: 一隻史萊姆走進酒館……然後就黏住了。
idle.en: A slime walks into a tavern... and sticks around.

idle.zh_TW: 為什麼金幣會笑？因為它很閃亮。
idle.en: Why is the gold coin smiling? It's feeling shiny.

idle.zh_TW: 我的武器說它今天不想上班。
idle.en: My weapon says it doesn't want to work today.

idle.zh_TW: 塔有幾層？比我想爬的多一層。
idle.en: How many floors? One more than I want to climb.

idle.zh_TW: 鳳凰為什麼不怕死？因為它有存檔。
idle.en: Why isn't the phoenix afraid of dying? It has a save file.

idle.zh_TW: 為什麼蜘蛛會上網？因為牠自己就是網。
idle.en: Why are spiders good online? They make their own web.

idle.zh_TW: 殭屍為什麼走很慢？因為它還沒睡醒。
idle.en: Why are zombies so slow? Still waking up.

idle.zh_TW: 為什麼鬼魂喜歡電梯？因為可以穿牆。
idle.en: Why do ghosts like elevators? They lift their spirits.

idle.zh_TW: 我數到三就出招……一、二……算了直接打。
idle.en: I'll strike on three... one, two... eh, now.

idle.zh_TW: 這怪的表情好像在想晚餐。
idle.en: This monster looks like it's thinking about dinner.

idle.zh_TW: 希望晚餐不是我。
idle.en: Hope dinner isn't me.

idle.zh_TW: 為什麼斧頭不受歡迎？因為它太會劈腿。
idle.en: Why is the axe unpopular? It keeps splitting up.

idle.zh_TW: 寶石為什麼不寂寞？因為它很有光彩。
idle.en: Why isn't the gem lonely? It's brilliant company.

idle.zh_TW: 我的護甲說它想放假。
idle.en: My armor says it wants a day off.

idle.zh_TW: 為什麼魔法書很重？因為內容很沉重。
idle.en: Why is the spellbook heavy? Heavy reading.

idle.zh_TW: 劍跟盾吵架了，誰會贏？當然是劍，它比較尖銳。
idle.en: Sword versus shield in an argument? Sword wins. Sharper point.

idle.zh_TW: 為什麼弓箭手很準時？因為他們總是瞄準時間。
idle.en: Why are archers punctual? They always aim for the time.

idle.zh_TW: 骷髏的樂團叫什麼？骨頭搖滾。
idle.en: What's a skeleton's band called? The Bone Rollers.

idle.zh_TW: 火山為什麼生氣？因為它一直在冒火。
idle.en: Why is the volcano angry? It keeps blowing its top.

idle.zh_TW: 海浪為什麼不累？因為它一直在休息（浪）。
idle.en: Why don't waves get tired? They just keep rolling.

idle.zh_TW: 我的冷笑話庫存快用完了。
idle.en: I'm running out of cold jokes.

idle.zh_TW: 沒關係，怪物也聽不懂。
idle.en: That's fine, the monsters don't get them anyway.

idle.zh_TW: 好，認真打了。
idle.en: Okay. Serious mode now.
